curse.blindness: The infusion violently destabilizes, wisps of magic cling to your body and cover your eyes
curse.fire: The infusion violently destabilizes, you begin to feel a smoldering heat building in your core and burst into flames
curse.rot.food: The infusion violently destabilizes, wisps of magic peer into your inventory, your food has rotted away
curse.hunger: The infusion violently destabilizes, wisps of magic peer into your soul and you begin to feel a ravenous hunger
curse.none: The infusion violently destabilizes, but nothing has happened
curse.pain: The infusion violently destabilizes, shards of dissolved matter pierce your body and you barely escape with your life
curse.wither: The infusion violently destabilizes, wisps of magic cling onto your body and wither it away
